newsitem.title: MEXICO: Contal sees April soft drinks price rise.
newsitem.headline: Contal sees April soft drinks price rise.

text.p: Mexican bottler Grupo Continental (Contal) sees an increase in soft drinks in April, a company executive told Reuters on Tuesday.
"We think there could be an increase in April, not before," Contal CFO Miguel Angel Rabago said.

"It also depends on the increase in the price of sugar cane. Unofficially there has also been an increase of 26 percent, but the growers said it was going to be announced in the Official Gazette," he added.
Rabago said cane prices accounted for 70 percent of production costs.
